newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed, awaits fresh news.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed, awaits fresh news.

text.p: White sugar futures were tightly mixed in Wednesday afternoon trading as the lack of fresh fundamental news and a rangebound New York market combined to dull sentiment in London.
Steady trade buying of the benchmark March contract kept the spot value supported but the upside momentum was not sufficient to attempt an assault on the psychological $300 barrier.
The March/May spread attracted limited trading interest as it slowly widened on account of a firmer March and slightly weaker May, as did August/October in the earlier part of the session.
"The market is very much locked in a range and I don't see it breaking out of it for the time being," one trader said.
At 1716 GMT March was down 10 cents at $298.20 and May down 40 cents at $297.10. Volume totalled 1,908 lots.
Market sources said the trade buying of March could only be viewed as contributing towards the overall physical delivery against March's expiry on February 13.
A high delivery cannot be excluded given the good supply of tenderable European sugars, including Polish, they said.
Technically, the outlook for March now appears more bearish as slow stochastic lines are poised to converge in overbought territory and short-term momentum indicators have turned lower.
The position is following a small upward trendline from last week's low of $293.30 and has now moved above its 10-day moving average at $297.10.
But it still faces a swathe of resistance arranged either side of $302, should it hazard an assault at the psychological $300 barrier, where traders said they expected sellers to cap gains.
Activity was lacklustre in Paris where volume totalled a light 516 lots.
March was up $1.00 at $299.00 and May was unchanged at $297.50.
